fact: From 6 August 2025 small and micro taxpayers can pay more than 70 types of tax and non-tax revenue by mobile phone through CASHTEL e-money, alongside LUMICASH, e-Noti/BANCOBU and FINBANK online payment channels.
title: Lancement du paiement des impôts et taxes via la plateforme CASHTEL, ce 6 août 2025 à l’Hôtel de Ville, à Bujumbura.
